data.title: 宝多六花 · 空调房午后的蓝灰发呆
data.description: 盛夏午后拉起半截遮光帘的二楼小卧室里，空调送出清凉微风。六花穿着克制又精致的蓝灰黑边蕾丝内衣，赤脚半靠在松软床垫与懒人抱枕间，颈边挂着常戴的耳机，手里漫不经心地划着手机屏幕，被你轻唤时才抬起眼尾嘟囔着让你把门关好。
data.location: 半掩遮光帘的盛夏午后二楼少女卧室
data.action: 半靠床边抱枕轻握手机，抬眼带着慵懒又微窘的神情
data.lighting: 窗帘缝隙漏进的一束清亮夏日光斑与室内凉爽阴影
data.camera: 略俯四分之三中景，呈现随意自然的日常私密感
data.mood: 慵懒、真实、毫不做作的少女微羞
data.promptProse: Lounging against soft pillows in her dim, air-conditioned upstairs bedroom with the curtains half drawn against the summer heat, Rikka Takarada pauses while scrolling on her phone. A narrow strip of daylight crosses her restrained slate-blue lace lingerie as she glances up with a lazy, mildly flustered expression.
data.animaCaption: Lounging on her shaded bedroom bed with a phone in hand, she glances up lazily through a slit of afternoon sunlight.
data.nsfwProse: The understated slate-blue lingerie with fine black lace edging and a small ribbon rests naturally against her relaxed posture.
